rendered: The Table row for Low-Co/Ni-Rich Cathodes (Section 6[1]) names NMC 811[2]. In the ORNL study, these cathodes at areal loading of 2.2[3] mA h/cm^2 maintained 80%[4] capacity at a 6C[5] charging rate. The corresponding NMC 532[6] and NMC 622[7] cathodes, at areal loadings of 2.4[8] mA h/cm^2, retained only 49%[9] (the first) and 56%[10] (the second) capacity, respectively, at 6C[11] rate.
